note: Back-of-shirt sponsor of Liaoning Tieren for the 2026 CSL season; the club announced the strategic partnership on 11 January 2026 (Dongqiudi/Tencent News). Rating note: the group's own subsidiaries page confirms Liaoning Hailiang Agriculture Group is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Hailiang Agriculture Group (claim hailiang-agriculture-ownership). The claim's named real owners (two natural persons, Lu Yiming and Wang Abing, per registry aggregator Qichamao) could not be verified: qichamao.com answers every address — real or made up — with the same login-wall page, so neither CI nor this review could open it, and no other openable page names the shareholders. 'nothing found' needs a claim naming the owner (CONTRIBUTING), so the sponsor stays unrated until a person opens the Qichamao page and confirms the shareholders section; if it holds, the record supports none (no state in the chain; a check for court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights findings against the group found none, searched 2026-10-03).
